newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling advances on large dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling advances on large dollar inflows.

text.p: Large dollar inflows from coffee and tea exporters helped the Kenyan shilling advance against the dollar on Wednesday, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a mean shilling average of 55.60 from 55.64 on Tuesday, while on the pound it was posted at 93.28 from 92.94.
Dealers said the dollar opened at 55.62/68 shillings and fell to 55.58/62 as coffee and tea exporters sold dollars.
"The shilling has also gained strength in the face of low importer demand. It appears that most importers are sitting on the sidelines hoping for a stronger shilling," a dealer said.
Some dealers expected sentiment to favour the shilling and said 55.60 was the next resistance level.
Overnight money market rates dropped to below 20 percent levels from Tuesday's 25 percent, as money flowed into the market from last week's treasury bill auction.
